description: This file defines the ConfigFileAPI class, a REST controller for handling configuration file updates during an installation or upgrade process of the OrangeHRM system. It manages writing configuration files, registration data, and database connection checks.

classes.name: ConfigFileAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class for managing configuration file creation, validation of database info, and registration data handling during system setup or upgrade.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes utility components for registration data and system configuration.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests; writes configuration files, checks database connection, and optionally sends registration data.

methods.name: sendRegistrationData
methods.description: Sends registration event data to the system and triggers success registration data transmission based on registration state.

methods.name: getRegistrationType
methods.description: Returns the registration type identifier for upgrader started registration.
